research_notes: Source policy: revenue, profit, EPS, balance-sheet levels, CFO and capex are from each year's own audited consolidated FS (bilingual, presented in US$, on medcoenergi.com), stored as originally reported in US$ million. Operating profit, EBITDA, ROE and ROA come from the 'Financial Highlights' table of the same year's annual report. Year-end prices come from each AR's share-price table. Dividends come from the AGMS minutes, board interim-dividend notices and the rupiah-rate notices posted on the IR site. FY2022 EPS is the only exception to 'own FS': see the EPS note.

Name and listing: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk (brand 'MedcoEnergi') is the current legal name. No rename was found (AR2025 cover and FS2025). Reporting currency is USD (all FS 2019-1H2026 'Expressed in United States Dollar').

Restatements: FY2019 was restated in FS2020 after the final Ophir purchase-price allocation. Loss attributable went from (27,347,601) to (38,765,488), total assets from 6,006.5 to 5,997.5 and equity attributable from 1,196.5 to 1,185.0. FS2020 also re-presents 2019 revenue as 1,375.7. FY2020 was restated in FS2021: total assets 5,882.7, equity attributable 1,007.4, loss (192.8). FS2022 re-presented FY2021 revenue to 1,252.1 and SG&A to 161.4 (discontinued operations). Later ARs print the restated figures. This file keeps the originally reported values and gives the restated ones in each datum's note, so year-on-year changes across a restatement boundary are not like-for-like.

EPS quality: FS2022 Note 40 divided total profit for the year incl. NCI (551,410,338) by weighted shares, giving 0.022055 for 2022 and 0.002497 for 2021. FS2023 corrected 2022 to 0.02123 (530,882,675 / 25,002,151,142), and the corrected figure is stored for FY2022. For FY2021 the original FS2021 figure 0.001875 is kept; it is correctly based on profit attributable. AR2022-AR2025 still print 0.00250 for 2021, and the IR dividend page still prints 0.022055 for 2022.

Amman Mineral (AMMN): PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk is an ASSOCIATE accounted for under the EQUITY METHOD ('Investment in shares', non-current), not consolidated. Effective ownership was 23.13% at end-2020 (FS2020 PDF p. 144; a 10% stake was reclassified to held-for-sale at end-2019 and sold in Feb 2020) and 20.92% at end-2025 (FS2025 Note 14, PDF p. 112), with carrying value US$1,165,511,490. The share of AMMN profit flows through 'Share of net profit of associates and joint venture', below the AR's operating profit and inside profit attributable. AMMN's July-2023 IPO gave MedcoEnergi a US$84m dilution gain (AR2023 PDF p. 23). AMMN results move MEDC's net income a lot: 2023 share US$55m vs US$253m in 2022 (AR2023 PDF p. 23), and the weak 2025 is partly AMMN.

Corporate actions since 2019-01-01: one rights issue only, PUT III. Ex 2020-09-09, 5:2 at Rp250, 7,141,951,545 new shares. Two related items are NOT corporate-action records: the Series I warrants from the 2017 PUT II (1:1 attached warrants, exercise windows to 11 Dec 2020, 78,197,793 exercised in 2020), and the PMHMETD IV approved by the AGMS of 26 Aug 2021 (up to 12.5bn new shares) but never implemented, as reported to the AGMS of 27 Jul 2022 (agenda 7). There has been no split, reverse split or bonus issue since the 2000 split (AR2025 PDF p. 123 'Historical Listings'). Issued shares have been 25,136,231,252 since end-2020. Treasury shares from buyback programmes (2021-2026) and their re-use for the share-ownership programme change shares_out: 65.5m (2020), 185.8m (2021), 110.9m (2022), 106.7m (2023), 71.5m (2024), 455.6m (2025), 409.3m (Jun 2026).

Dividends: declared in USD (or, for the 2023/2024 interims and the FY2024 final, in rupiah per share). dps is the rupiah amount per share paid to Indonesian-domiciled holders, set at the BI middle rate on the recording date; holders domiciled abroad were paid in USD. total is the USD amount (US$ million) as approved/stated by the board or AGMS. No dividend for FY2019 (loss of US$27.3m as originally reported) or FY2020 (AGMS 26 Aug 2021). An FY2026 interim of US$30m (ex 2026-11-11) was announced on 2026-11-02; its rupiah dps will only be fixed on 2026-11-13.

Operating profit and EBITDA: the FS face has no operating-profit line; the stored figure is the AR's 'Operating profit' (gross profit less SG&A). EBITDA is the AR figure; the company publishes no reconciliation, and the AR glossary only expands the acronym. Both figures are restated in later ARs (e.g. FY2020 EBITDA 502.2 in AR2020, 494.5 in AR2021-23, 452.1 in AR2024; FY2021 713.5 vs 667.3). The originally printed values are stored. Interim EBITDA (805.1 / 616.1) is from the 1H26 results deck.

fx_usd_idr: MedcoEnergi's FS print the closing rate only as 'Rupiah/US$1 0,0000xx' (US$ per rupiah, 6 dp), which is too coarse to invert. The stored value is Bank Indonesia's middle rate (mean of BI's published kurs beli/jual) on the balance-sheet date, which FS Note 2e says is the rate used. Source: BI's public web service. It agrees with the rounded FS figure every year, and with FS2025 Note 45 (Rp362,838m = US$21,620,647, i.e. 16,782; 2024: 16,162).

total_debt = short-term bank loans + bank loans + loans from non-bank financial institutions + Rupiah bonds + US Dollar bonds + medium-term notes (current and non-current, net of unamortised costs as presented), excluding lease liabilities. It matches the company's 'consolidated debt' (AR2023: US$3,295m for 2023; 1H26 press release: US$4,128m). FY2020 excludes the Sarulla (MGeoPS) project loans held inside liabilities of the held-for-sale disposal group.

Production: the 'production' datum is MedcoEnergi's net (working-interest) oil & gas production incl. the Oman Karim Small Fields service contract. It comes from the AR 'Net Oil & Gas Production (mboepd)' table: AR2025 for 2021-2025, AR2024 for 2020. Older ARs label series differently (AR2020/AR2021 'Total Oil & Gas Production' excludes Oman: 93.0 for 2020, 86.9 for 2021; AR2022 prints the lifting series 155.2 as 'Total' for 2022). One consistent table was therefore used rather than each year's own AR.

Interim: 1H2026 audited interim consolidated FS (auditor's report 21 Sep 2026, 5-column format incl. unaudited 1H2025). The 9M2026 FS was not on medcoenergi.com as of 2026-11-03 (the 9M2025 results came out on 2025-11-03, so it is probably imminent). The validator warns on profit YoY (+797%). That growth is real: 1H25 US$30.7m was depressed, and the deck (PDF p. 16) shows 275.3 vs 30.7.
